people.name: Scott Young (ice hockey, born 1967)
people.extract: Scott Allen Young is an American professional ice hockey coach and former player who most recently served as an assistant coach for the Vancouver Canucks of the National Hockey League (NHL). Young previously served as director of player development for the Canucks as well as for the Pittsburgh Penguins.
highlights: American professional ice hockey coach and former player.
Assistant coach for the Vancouver Canucks (NHL).
Director of player development for Canucks and Penguins.

people.name: Saint Cajetan
people.extract: Gaetano dei Conti di Thiene, known in English as Saint Cajetan, was an Italian Catholic priest and religious reformer, co-founder of the Theatines. He is recognised as a saint in the Catholic Church, and his feast day is 7 August.
highlights: Italian Catholic priest and religious reformer.
Recognised as a saint in the Catholic Church.

people.name: John Bligh, 3rd Earl of Darnley
people.extract: John Bligh, 3rd Earl of Darnley, styled The Honourable John Bligh between 1721 and 1747, lord of the Manor of Cobham, Kent, was a British parliamentarian.
highlights: Lord of the Manor of Cobham, Kent.
